choices.text: An extra blind posted before cards, often by under the gun. This trainer does not deal it.
A tournament ante that doubles the blinds
A rule that the button acts first on the flop

questions.explanation: Conceptually the straddler is a bigger big blind and acts last preflop. The first voluntary actor sits to their left.

choices.text: Everyone posts, there is no preflop betting, and the hand starts on the flop. This trainer does not deal it.
A normal open to 3 big blinds
A side pot from a short stack

questions.explanation: Ranges are random and wide. Play for nut potential, not for a preflop raiser’s range advantage.

questions.prompt: Running it twice, after an all-in, …

choices.text: Deals the remaining board twice and splits the pot by board. It reduces variance. It does not change a fair all-in price. This trainer does not offer it.
Lets you fold after you see the first board

questions.explanation: If you were getting the right price once, you are getting it on each run. You are not twice as good.

choices.text: A side bet that pays when you are ahead and lose the runout. It is not a poker action, and this app does not sell it.
The same as running it twice

questions.explanation: Do not confuse a proposition bet with the hand. Your poker decision is still the all-in price.
